system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: Self

Area: 5-space-radius

You create a storm of lightning that follows you and strikes at all who approach you.

The area within a 5-space-radius around you becomes a Hazard (3) trait and Difficult Terrain for all creatures other than yourself.

The affected area moves with you.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.

Additionally, you may spend an additional 1 Resolve when you activate this ability so that your allies are unaffected by it for the duration.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.5AKIP59UYgN1Wi7m]{Stormcaller's Grasp}
